component: L-band cross-pol radar backscatter gamma0_HV (10*log10(HVHV), frequencyA)
colormap: viridis (dark = bare/dry soil or open water, bright = irrigated crop canopy / vegetation volume)
source: NISAR L2 GCOV (PROVISIONAL, CRID P05023) via ASF DAAC, track 34 ascending frame 20; https://nisar-docs.asf.alaska.edu/gcov
notes: Geocoded terrain-corrected cross-polarisation backscatter gamma0_HV in dB (10*log10(science/LSAR/GCOV/grids/frequencyA/HVHV)) resampled from UTM Zone 11N (EPSG:32611, 160 m stride) onto a regular 0.001 deg lon/lat grid covering [-120.2, 35.6, -119.0, 36.6]. All 8 provisional dates share a fixed colour scale [-28, -10] dB.
quality_note: NISAR data are provisional. Calibration and validation are carried out by the NISAR project (NASA-JPL and ISRO), not by our team.
